text:
Hello again lovelies!

Noa Konyevsky and I are wondering how to go about getting permission to apply for a spouse visa in Israel.

1. Do I take all the documents needed for the full spouse visa to the embassy to get permission to enter to apply and THEN apply
OR
2. Do I go to the embassy with different documents to get permission to enter to apply for the spouse visa once I arrive

I am a bit lost on how this process goes because it just seems like I am applying from abroad just to get permission to enter israel to apply again? I thought it would be more of a 'here are a few documents', 'thanks you can go to israel to apply for the spouse visa', 'awesome i applied in israel and got the temporary B1'.

Additionally, how long did it take for you guys to get permission to enter israel to apply, I see anywhere from 30-90 days.

Context: I am a british citizen living in Hungary, my wife Noa is Israeli and living in Hungary but maintains an address in Israel.

Thanks!
